literal_meaning: ধরা এবং পাকড়ানো (ধরে রাখা এবং আঁকড়ে ধরা)
figurative_meaning_en: Earnest and persistent pleading for a favor
example_sentences_in_bangla: চাকরির জন্য একে ওকে ধরপাকড় করছি।
example_sentences_in_english: I'm pestering everyone for a job.
I had to plead earnestly with my friends for help.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali social dynamics in seeking assistance.
